title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Implant Cat 4, Day 0
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzijp4e
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Empty Bladder Cat transitioned back to isoflurane

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room for monitoring.

substeps.instruction: Drape the animal
Perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder via the urethra using surgilube.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met
Pull the catheter back 2-3cm

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Withdraw 15 mL of urine from the bladder using gentle suction with a syringe for urinalysis.

steps.title: Perform Initial Bladder CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline and capture CT images at incremental volumes.

substeps.instruction: Take CT images of the empty bladder (timestamps 9:12:51 and 9:17:38)
Fill bladder with 10 mL contrast and take a single CT image
Add 10 mL more (total 20 mL) and take a single CT image
Add 5 mL more (total 25 mL) and take a single CT image
Add 5 mL more (total 30 mL) and take a single CT image
Take a 3D CT image with 30 mL contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Perform Baseline Cystometry
steps.instruction: Transfer the cat from isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and record bladder pressure using Labview software and an external pressure transducer.

substeps.instruction: Set syringe pump fill rate to 2 mL saline/minute
Fill bladder with saline to 30 mL and record pressure
Note pressure plateau around 25 mL (possible leak point)
Observe for reflex contractions by tugging on the catheter while animal is held at 30 mL saline

steps.title: Implant Device in Bladder
steps.instruction: Access and open the bladder following the 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol and implant the device.

substeps.instruction: Make a 1 cm incision in the bladder
Place the device in the bladder
Suture the bladder closed and check for leaks
Suture the bladder mucosal layer using 4-0 Vicryl Polysorb
Suture the bladder muscle using 4-0 Vicryl Polysorb
Suture the fascia/muscle using 3-0 Prolene
Suture the fat layer using 4-0 Vicryl Polysorb
Suture the skin using 3-0 Monosof Nylon (11 non-continuous sutures)
Place the bladder back into the body

steps.title: Perform Post-Implantation CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Capture DYNA-CT and 3D CT images to verify device placement and check for leaks.

substeps.instruction: Take a picture of the device in the empty bladder (11:28:33)
Take a 3D CT (11:29:41)
Image contrast in the bladder with the device (11:30:16)
Image 10 mL contrast in the bladder with the device (11:31:16), noting any leakage around the catheter
Image 20 mL contrast in the bladder with the device (11:35:37)
Perform a final 3D CT scan

steps.title: Perform Post-Implantation Leak Test
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at a rate of 2 mL/min to check for leaks.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 19 mL and observe for saline leaking around the catheter

steps.title: Recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the cat to wake up and return it to the housing site.
